title: Photographs of underground treasure cavern

tellings.quote: I've seen photographs of of the I mean it looks it's like a football stadium down underneath the ground, you know,

plain: Dan Sheehan, an American lawyer, says he has seen photographs of a huge underground cavern in the Philippines, linked to around 1945, holding a hoard of treasure. He says it looks like a football stadium beneath the ground. If true, it would mean an enormous hidden fortune was stashed there.
